name: Wildwood
source:
Wildwood is a short anthology visual novel about fairy tales and folklore from Europe, Britain and Russia. 

[From [url=https://ogdred.itch.io/wildwood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Wildwood》是一部短篇故事集形式的视觉小说，取材于欧洲、英国和俄罗斯的童话与民间传说。

[摘自[url=https://ogdred.itch.io/wildwood]Itch.io[/url]]
